title: Geometric realisations of type $\tilde{A}_n$ preprojective algebras in homological mirror symmetry
summary: The type $A_n$-singularity $\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{Z}_{n+1}$ can be resolved by hyper-Kähler manifolds $X_ζ$ with underlying smooth manifolds diffeomorphic to the resolution of singularities $X_{\text{res}}$, whose hyper-Kähler structure depends on a parameter $ζ\in H_2(X_{\text{res}};\mathbb{R})$.
